length_estimate.assumption: Historical constant-D-section estimate only: same net chamber volume and target tuning as the original round trial port, using an equal-area circular end correction. The current circular entrance, variable-area transition and rounded mouths are not represented by this estimate. The selected 90 mm total length is a user-approved trial following the updated chamber size, not the result of this equal-volume comparison.

view_convention: Clock positions seen from outside facing the rear panel. Installed X right, Z up, +Y into cabinet; flat tube top at 12 o'clock, relief at 10 o'clock. Four screw holes on PCD50 at 45, 135, 225 and 315 degrees from +X toward +Z.
notes: User confirmed 25 mm is the tube outer height, and authorized provisional screw-post relief for a trial version.

The 10 o'clock relief is a continuous flat 10 mm inward, as requested by the user, from the nominal outer circle along its 10 o'clock radius. Actual post position, extent and required clearance are unknown.
User confirmed 12 mm rear panel thickness and a round wood hole. The complete 0..12 mm insertion segment has circular OD38; the D exterior and clock10 relief begin at the panel inside face Y=12 mm.

The bore changes gradually from round to D between Y=-1 and Y=12 inside the base/collar, so the full D exterior can begin directly behind the panel without an internal blocking ledge. The transition has locally thicker walls.

Both airway mouth edges have inward R1.5 fillets cut from existing material, without increasing the installation envelope; nominal straight walls remain 3 mm and the interior D-mouth lip is locally 1.5 mm thick.
This independent print part does not modify the main assembly, roof plates, drawings or acoustic validation.
